# ADR-3224: AWS network: Security group reference cycles for tier 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Cycles obscure effective permissions.

## Decision

Architectures MUST NOT create security group reference cycles for tier 8 (AWS-network-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Tiered SG designs are documented.
